correctness.rationale: Exact positive planar-to-scalar equivalence and inverse lift verified. The log-coordinate forcing is strictly decreasing with derivative magnitude strictly below 1, so cyclic integration by parts and the discrete Fourier spectral gap exclude all nonconstant periods q=2..6, including strict contradiction at q=6. For lambda=5 two exact rational residuals of opposite sign construct an actual positive 7-cycle by IVT, and primality of seven ensures least period. Standalone exact checker passed.

value.rationale: The geometric-series aggregation threshold k=1 is the natural ecological stability boundary of May’s host-parasitoid system; local linear ellipticity does not settle existence of nonlinear cycles. The theorem gives a sharp universal finite least-period gap and a constructive positive extreme orbit for a genuine biological parameter, providing a useful structural nonlinear restriction distinct from boundedness or two-cycle checks.
